author: @jeremyfowers

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking changes. HF_TOKEN continues to take precedence. This is an additive fallback; existing setups that rely on HF_TOKEN are unaffected. The behavior change is purely what happens when HF_TOKEN is not set.
evidence.documentation: Small QoL feature matching huggingface_hub behavior. No new CLI commands, config options, or API endpoints. No documentation changes required.
evidence.manual_release_testing: This commit adds user-visible behavior: a token file that 'hf auth login' writes is now used for Hugging Face API requests. No evidence a human exercised this path end-to-end. The tester should verify the token file is read when HF_TOKEN is unset.
evidence.post_approval_commits: One commit (4ccc1102) was added after the approval at 2026-11-19T19:29:04Z. It adds a try/catch around the default cache directory lookup — the same change suggested by @danielholanda in an inline comment. It does not add new behavior, change API/CLI/GUI, or weaken tests. The change is minimal and follows reviewer guidance, though it was not re-approved.
evidence.review: One substantive human reviewer (@danielholanda) approved the PR. All CI checks passed. The review comment from CodeRabbit flagged XDG_CACHE_HOME and path expansion concerns; these were not addressed in the final code. The reviewer approved before these concerns were fully resolved, but the issues are low-risk for typical setups.
evidence.security: The token is read from standard Hugging Face locations (HF_TOKEN_PATH > $HF_HOME/token > default cache dir) and used only as a Bearer Authorization header for Hugging Face API calls. No new credential exposure, network paths, or permission changes. The try/catch prevents an exception from crashing when HOME is unset.
evidence.tests: No new tests were added. The change is a single new function with straightforward logic matching huggingface_hub's documented precedence. No existing tests were weakened or deleted.

maintainer_todos.text: Unset HF_TOKEN, start the Lemonade server, and request a model that requires authentication; confirm the request succeeds using the token file instead of failing with 401 Unauthorized.

shout_outs.reason: Co-author of the commit; reviewed the PR, suggested the try/catch error handling for the default token path, and the fix was incorporated.

subject: feat: read the Hugging Face token file when HF_TOKEN is unset (#4213)
summary: Adds a huggingface_token() function that falls back from HF_TOKEN env var to HF_TOKEN_PATH, then $HF_HOME/token, then ~/.cache/huggingface/token — matching huggingface_hub so that users who ran 'hf auth login' get authenticated requests automatically.
verdict_reason: New user-reachable token-file reading behavior was merged without evidence of manual end-to-end testing before release.
